svg.desc: Figure 1. SHMtrace: control-calibrated somatic hypermutation calling, from inputs and read preparation through calling, quality checks and outputs.

Calling: a test for reads, a count for Sanger clones
Reads (nanopore, Illumina, UMI): tested against controls
